ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white/light gray) concentrated in the central and right lobe regions, with 35% low-intensity pixels (black/dark gray) appearing as mottling and solid patches along the trailing edges and lower left quadrant.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light-intensity zone spanning the center of both lobes. Distinct dark-intensity vertical band separating the left lobe from the median notch area. Dense dark mottling concentrated on the interior margin of the left lobe and along the full extent of the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 35 degrees, extending inward significantly towards the fluke base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire visible boundary. Notable cluster of sharp, irregular pixel peaks (saw-tooth pattern) on the superior curve of the left lobe, transitioning to smaller, more frequent irregular notches towards the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a sharp convex arc upward with a vertical orientation before tapering. Right lobe displays a more horizontal, elongated convex sweep towards the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of high-intensity (white) circular pixel groupings on the lateral-most edge of the left lobe and smaller clusters near the water-line boundary on the lower left lobe, consistent with sessile organism attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of at least four parallel, low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the light-intensity region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular 'chewed' or jagged loss of tissue on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe, and multiple sets of linear rake marks on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark patch shaped like a downward-pointing triangle located immediately to the left of the median notch.
